title: The 7th Continent
subtitle: A cooperative choose-your-own-adventure survival game across an uncharted cursed land
tagline: You are the hero: explore, survive, craft, and lift the curse
loreSummary: It is the early twentieth century. Returning from an expedition to the mysterious newly discovered Seventh Continent, you find yourself afflicted by a supernatural curse. To survive, you must return to this perilous land, forage, craft tools, uncover ancient secrets, and break the curse before your life energy runs out.
keyFeatures: Groundbreaking card-based open world that unfolds organically as you explore
Action deck mechanic where your stamina, life force, and actions share the same resource
Clever save-and-resume system enabling 30-second setup and teardown
Non-linear survival sandbox with deep crafting, hunting, foraging, and mystery solving

t7c_voracious_goddess.name: The Voracious Goddess (Single Curse)
t7c_voracious_goddess.description: The quintessential introductory curse campaign. Journey through the primeval northern territories to uncover and purge the demonic spiritual affliction (approx. 8 expeditions).

t7c_classic_curses.name: The Classic Tri-Curse Chronicle
t7c_classic_curses.description: The complete core box chronicle featuring 'The Voracious Goddess', 'The Bloody Hunt', and 'An Offering to the Guardians' (approx. 20 expeditions).

t7c_grand_explorer.name: The Grand Continent Expedition (All Curses)
t7c_grand_explorer.description: The ultimate survival marathon challenging all four original curses simultaneously or consecutively across every corner of the continent (approx. 28 expeditions).

milestones.title: Castaway on Cursed Shores
milestones.description: Waking stranded on the uncharted shores of the continent, crafting rudimentary survival gear, and unearthing the first cryptic clues.

milestones.title: The Whispering Monoliths
milestones.phase: Expedition Phase II - Into the Heart of Peril
milestones.description: Navigating treacherous jungle canopies, discovering towering ancient effigies, and decoding stone glyphs that reveal the curse's true origin.

milestones.title: Banishment of the Voracious Goddess
milestones.phase: Expedition Phase III - The First Rite of Cleansing
milestones.description: Reaching the forbidden volcanic sanctuary, making the perilous offering, and purging the devastating spiritual malady.

milestones.title: Trial of the Predatory Hunt
milestones.phase: Expedition Phase IV - Masters of the Wilderness
milestones.description: Stalking legendary beasts through subterranean labyrinths and appeasing the gargantuan island guardians.

milestones.title: Sovereign of the Seventh Realm
milestones.phase: Expedition Phase V - Breaking the Final Shackles
milestones.description: Lifting all dark afflictions from your soul and charting an escape route back across the ocean to the civilized world.
